description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different categories in a dataset. There are seven slices in the chart, each representing a different category. The categories are Math, Coding, Information Seeking, Reasoning, Planning, Creative Writing, and Others (combined). The Math category has the largest slice, accounting for 29.3% of the total. The Coding category has the second largest slice, accounting for 22.2% of the total. The Information Seeking category has the third largest slice, accounting for 10.4% of the total. The Reasoning category has the fourth largest slice, accounting for 9.3% of the total. The Planning category has the fifth largest slice, accounting for 2.3% of the total. The Creative Writing category has the sixth largest slice, accounting for 2.2% of the total. The Others (combined) category has the smallest slice, accounting for 1.4% of the total. The chart includes a legend that lists the categories and their corresponding colors. The percentages are labeled inside the slices. The chart does not include any visual emphasis on any of the slices.
